summary.handoff: from a proposed diagnostic output to the decisions it should support
from intended use to declared operating conditions
from six dimensions to Methodology for their construction
from advertised robustness to missing-data, perturbation and external-control limits
from case rationale through a proposed plan to a forecast, not an observed intervention outcome

introduction.handoff: from competing present/future needs to an allocation task
from a definition to the stability dimensions the index is to represent
from unmet needs and candidate policies into the following construction section; a chapter-position variant of candidate 01, not another independent pattern

provisional_section_contracts.input: A proposed national sustainability assessment and its decision audience.
provisional_section_contracts.rhetorical_job: Preview purpose, assumptions, construction, limits and the selected demonstration.
provisional_section_contracts.analytical_job: Condense the intended diagnostic and forecasting workflow without introducing a newly proved result.
provisional_section_contracts.output: A six-dimensional assessment promise and a conditional case-study outlook.
provisional_section_contracts.handoff: Introduction explains the prioritisation need; Methodology is explicitly named as the construction source.

provisional_section_contracts.input: Competing development needs, limited resources and an uncertain future.
provisional_section_contracts.rhetorical_job: Move from motivation through an operational definition and trade-off to a concrete analytical objective.
provisional_section_contracts.analytical_job: Define what the index is meant to describe and how policy changes should be related to it.
provisional_section_contracts.handoff: Methodology must specify the dimensions and conventions required by that link.

provisional_section_contracts.input: The operational stability concept and reported external datasets.
provisional_section_contracts.rhetorical_job: Explain output uses, disclose common conventions and introduce six component meanings.
provisional_section_contracts.analytical_job: Describe the six subindices and the asymmetric screening interpretation; precise equations remain unverified in this text-only repair.
provisional_section_contracts.output: A stated six-component representation on a common scale, not a newly reconstructed single scalar.
provisional_section_contracts.handoff: Results apply the stated procedure to contrasting cases; the case study then uses it to motivate priorities.

provisional_section_contracts.input: The described subindex procedure and eight deliberately varied cases.
provisional_section_contracts.rhetorical_job: Explain the comparison sample and demonstrate the intended comparative use.
provisional_section_contracts.analytical_job: Present the authors' between-case comparison; visual efficacy and universal applicability are not established by this review.
provisional_section_contracts.output: A purposive illustration and a transition to a selected planning case.
provisional_section_contracts.handoff: Case Study: Bhutan introduces eligibility and excludes complicating conditions.

provisional_section_contracts.input: A tractable selected case, the described index and two explicitly assigned comparator roles.
provisional_section_contracts.rhetorical_job: Move from selection and context through sector interpretations to actionable priorities.
provisional_section_contracts.analytical_job: Use reported scores/components, conditional future needs and controllability limits to motivate action.
provisional_section_contracts.output: Priorities for education, transport, sanitation, health and building standards, with a no-action expectation for persistent social issues.
provisional_section_contracts.handoff: The following plan turns these diagnoses and national priorities into proposed programmes.

provisional_section_contracts.input: Diagnosed sector needs and the national priorities cited by the paper.
provisional_section_contracts.rhetorical_job: Make recommendations concrete through components, conditions, allocation criteria, intended outcomes and delivery partners.
provisional_section_contracts.analytical_job: Describe proposed educational, transport, infrastructure and supplementary economic actions; costs and causal efficacy are not newly verified.
provisional_section_contracts.output: A scoped twenty-year programme and stated intentions.
provisional_section_contracts.handoff: The next section assigns selected future input changes; this is an assumption handoff, not an estimated response function.

provisional_section_contracts.input: The proposed programme and selected baseline input values.
provisional_section_contracts.rhetorical_job: Declare the boundary between changed inputs and the fixed remainder.
provisional_section_contracts.analytical_job: Specify a scenario horizon and an all-unmentioned-values-fixed rule; table contents remain outside this repair.
provisional_section_contracts.output: A stated scenario-input convention, not a calibrated intervention-effect model.
provisional_section_contracts.handoff: Projected-result prose reports the consequence of those assumed updates.

provisional_section_contracts.input: The authors' updated scenario inputs and unchanged remainder.
provisional_section_contracts.rhetorical_job: Summarise a favourable direction while preserving the environmental exception and its external driver.
provisional_section_contracts.analytical_job: Interpret the reported conditional projection without reading fresh plot values or inferring causal identification.
provisional_section_contracts.output: A qualified overall outlook with one explicitly non-improving sector.
provisional_section_contracts.handoff: Strengths and Weaknesses limits the accuracy, robustness, representation and agency implied by that outlook.

provisional_section_contracts.input: The described assessment, scenario and acknowledged data/representation constraints.
provisional_section_contracts.rhetorical_job: Bound reliability and interpretation, then convert explicit limits into a finite future-work agenda.
provisional_section_contracts.analytical_job: Distinguish conditional robustness, category distortion, external control, critical component conditions and proposed repairs.
provisional_section_contracts.output: A bounded use case and prospective checks for missing inputs, weights, screening thresholds and extreme components.
provisional_section_contracts.handoff: The author-written text ends; References supplies provenance rather than another analytical conclusion.

observable_handoff_chain: scarcity and competing needs -> prioritisation task
tractable case and diagnostic findings -> aligned priorities
priorities -> specified programme components, recipients and delivery actors
programme -> assumed input updates plus a fixed remainder
updated scenario -> qualified projection with an environmental exception
reported result -> accuracy/agency limits and targeted future checks
